_readme: Hand-checked decisions for 03-existing-geometry.mjs. keep = never rebuild. confirmed = the mapped relation is this trail even though the stored line is too damaged to prove it geometrically. parts = build the line from these pieces in order; a piece with from/to is the walk along that relation's ways between two anchors (a place name near the relation, or [lng, lat]).

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.why: OSM relation 21149649 'Stepantsminda–Gergeti Church' is this hike (it passes 11 m from the church); the stored line has 3 points

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.why: the two Transcaucasian Trail stage relations Mestia–Adishi and Adishi–Ushguli, as mapped in the original import script; the stored line has 7 points

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.why: relation 3817920 'Roshka - Juta' was deleted from OSM; 17899876 'Chaukhi Pass Trail' replaces it and offers one line between the two villages (only a 34 m variant)

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004.why: no relation of its own; Omalo to Dartlo is the first stage of relation 21145876 'Omalo–Shatili', which has a single line between the two villages; the stored line has 2 points

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005.why: relation 21149704 'Truso Valley' from its trailhead at Kvemo Okrokana to Zakagori Fortress (the trail's last checkpoint); the relation's other members are short spurs to springs and viewpoints; the stored line has 2 points

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006.why: the owner redrew this trail in the admin panel (Ninoskhevi Waterfall, 791 points, no jumps); the relation from the original import (Black Grouse Waterfall) no longer applies

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007.why: the trail starts at the Likani park entrance (its first checkpoint); OSM draws the relation from the Marelisi end

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008.why: the Juta side of relation 17899876 'Chaukhi Pass Trail' up to the Chaukhi Pass node; the stored line was a 4 km piece of the deleted relation 3817920

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010.why: the stored 2-point line lies about 13 km south-west of Okatse Canyon (near the Martvili/Okatse road junction) and no OSM relation exists for the canyon walk; the trail has to be drawn by hand

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011.why: no relation of its own; relation 12211099 'Omalo-Shatili' has a single line between Shatili and Mutso; the stored line has 15 points covering 0.3 km

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012.why: relation 15354522 'Mukhuri - Tobavarchkhili Lakes - Skuri' between its two villages; the stored line has 2 points

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000025.why: relation 15378089 'Lukhi — Okrotskali Lakes Trail' as mapped in the original import; the stored line has 28 points covering a tenth of it

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000035.why: relation 3817760 'Omalo - Atsunta' was deleted from OSM; 21145876 'Omalo–Shatili' now runs from Omalo to the Atsunta Pass node and relation 12211099 continues from that node down to Shatili

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000036.why: relation 12211128 'Omalo–Diklo' has a detached piece 576 m away, but a single line between the two villages

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000038.why: the trail is now two relations in OSM that meet in Chigho: 13316316 (Diklo–Chigho) and 21147132 'Diklo–Chigho–Dartlo' (Chigho–Dartlo)

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000046.why: relation 3740333 'St. Andrew’s Trail' as mapped in the original import; the stored line covers a fifth of it

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000047.why: relation 3740346 'Shepherd's trail' is a line with one side branch; the stored route starts and ends at two of its three ends, which leaves exactly one line

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000056.why: relation 15656966 'Kojori — Kabeni Monastery — Kabeni Waterfalls Trail' as mapped in the original import (the relation has been extended since)

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000109.why: relation 14078002 'Gulebi Fortress route' (same name); the stored line walks it twice with a 1.8 km jump

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000121.why: relation 3818361 'Mestia - Zabeshi' (same name); the stored line covers 41% of it

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000122.why: relation 14916523 (same name); the stored line has a 4.6 km jump

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000130.why: relation 17899876 (formerly 'Roshka - Juta', now 'Chaukhi Pass Trail') between the two villages

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000140.why: relation 19410123 'Transcaucasian Trail' (same name); the stored line has 21 points
